mapper.select:
SELECT a.`id`, a.`record_id`, a.`item_name` `itemName`, a.`stop_time` `stopTime`, a.`start_time` `startTime`, a.`total_circle` `totalCircle`, a.`total_time` `totalTime`, a.`area_id`, a.`area_name`, a.`client_id` `clientId`, a.`client_name` `clientName` FROM `play_record` a where a.`deleted` = 0
and a.`client_name` like concat('%', #{param.keyword}, '%') or a.`item_name` like concat('%', #{param.keyword}, '%')
and a.`start_time` BETWEEN #{param.period.begin} and #{param.period.end}
order by a.`create_time` DESC
